description: Merges two identities of one person (a phone number and a BSUID): the contact named by id keeps going, and the one named by from is folded into it and removed. It cannot be undone. Each merge needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that names both contacts and returns a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it merges. Returns the contact that remains.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: merge_contacts
title: Merge two contacts
